north_star:
Turn differentiated, trustworthy market intelligence into recurring customer value and durable revenue without weakening evidence, uncertainty, correction, or paper-only boundaries.
Make Prophet, Macro Dashboard, Sector Intelligence, Research Vault, Terminal, and Options Intelligence production-ready, interoperable, and valuable enough that the combined product is sellable.
Deliver one coherent premium desktop/mobile experience whose navigation and state flow make the intelligence feel like one investment desk, not a collection of unrelated tools.
Establish a repeatable acquisition -> activation -> retention -> revenue loop and let distribution become the dominant company bias after the SELL_READY gate.
Use governed AI autonomy as a force multiplier for product, research, and growth; autonomy infrastructure is a means to company throughput, not an endless product category of its own.

priorities.objective: Bring Prophet, Macro Dashboard, Sector Intelligence, Research Vault, Terminal, and Options Intelligence to measured production-ready, sellable states. Maximize end-user decision value, frequency of useful use, differentiation, trust, and cross-product compounding; connect them into a Market -> Sector -> Opportunity -> Security -> Thesis -> Positioning workflow. New product-category expansion stays constrained until SELL_READY unless it directly closes a measured core gap.

Unify customer-facing Mastermind into one fast, premium, user-friendly desktop/mobile product with a coherent design language, information architecture, navigation model, state continuity, accessibility, and real-path acceptance. Remove dead ends, inconsistent UX/CSS, AI-generated residue, and slow or confusing mobile paths rather than polishing isolated screens in place.

Build the commercial spine and distribution foundations now: signup, onboarding, activation, trial, billing, entitlement, conversion, retention and attribution; product-led shareability; creator, affiliate and partnership channels; and high-velocity AI-assisted growth experiments. After SELL_READY, shift the company resource bias toward distribution. Scale paid acquisition only when retained value and contribution economics justify it.

Production-prove a governed objective -> decomposition -> routing -> worker execution -> independent review/repair -> integration/recovery/continuation loop that removes routine Chairman message shuttling, session hunting, watcher repair, and account selection. ChatGPT Web is an optional execution surface, not a completion dependency. After AUTONOMY_BASELINE passes, autonomy infrastructure defaults to maintenance unless a concrete active-P0 blocker requires expansion.

Retired as a company P0 on 2026-11-06 and subsumed by CORE_INTELLIGENCE_PRODUCTIZATION. Historical objective: reduce structural late-entry behavior in US Prophet without unacceptable false-positive cost.
Retired as a company P0 on 2026-11-06 and subsumed by PREMIUM_PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE. Historical objective: remove unfinished-product signals, inconsistent UX/CSS, dead surfaces, and confusing structure.

Retired as a company P0 on 2026-11-06 and subsumed by DISTRIBUTION_AND_REVENUE. Historical objective: complete signup, trial, billing, entitlement, paywall, activation, analytics, and lifecycle paths for revenue.
Retired as a company P0 on 2026-11-06 and subsumed by DISTRIBUTION_AND_REVENUE. Historical objective: prove the first repeatable path from zero traffic to qualified prospects and paying users.

Retired as a company P0 on 2026-11-06 and subsumed by AUTONOMY_FORCE_MULTIPLIER. Existing Executive OS remains the canonical lifecycle and admission owner; this retirement changes company-priority classification, not runtime authority or accepted implementation ownership.

Retired as a company P0 on 2026-11-06 and subsumed by AUTONOMY_FORCE_MULTIPLIER. The existing Meta-CEO Chairman Cognition capability and constitutional Chairman boundaries remain intact as subordinate autonomy capabilities rather than a separate company objective.

AUTONOMY_BASELINE.purpose: End autonomy-infrastructure critical-path mode once the organization can reliably execute and recover governed multi-worker work without routine Chairman orchestration.
criteria: the accepted Autonomy V1 production-proof matrix, or its accepted successor, is satisfied
governed decomposition and multi-worker routing are production-proven
independent review, bounded repair, and exact parent consumption are proven
worker or session failure recovery is proven without routine Chairman shuttling
at least one durable non-ChatGPT-Web execution path is production-proven
current lifecycle, effect, source-custody, and continuation owners remain singular
AUTONOMY_BASELINE.on_pass: Review autonomy allocation downward toward maintenance. New provider, host, browser, or orchestration infrastructure must then name the active P0 and concrete production limitation it unlocks.

SELL_READY.purpose: Mark the point where Mastermind is coherent and valuable enough to sell, so the company can shift from build-dominant launch convergence toward distribution-dominant growth.
criteria: all six core intelligence products clear production-readiness and user-value review
premium desktop and mobile cross-product journeys pass real-path acceptance
the Market -> Sector -> Opportunity -> Security -> Thesis -> Positioning workflow is coherent
signup, onboarding, activation, trial, billing, entitlement, conversion, and analytics are live
freshness, sources, uncertainty, corrections, falsifiers, and material limitations are visible
SELL_READY.on_pass: Trigger an explicit Chairman/CEO resource-policy review in which distribution becomes the dominant company bias. Do not wait for product perfection; continue product work where retention, trust, or measured user value shows a real gap.
